description: Submit a time-boxed deal — a lifetime deal, a sale, or a launch offer — for the product (POST /api/agent/deals). Use this when the product has a current discount, an LTD, or a launch price that should appear on https://altimateguide.com/deals. Provide the page that documents the offer (`dealUrl`) — every deal is verified against it. Review is 7 calendar days free, or 2 business days with a paid listing's `paymentRef`. `endsAt` is optional: omit it for an open-ended offer. A deal NEVER changes the listing's link tier — dofollow is earned through the listing paths (badge / SayAbout.Us / paid listing). Requires a token (run complete_login, or set ALTIMATEGUIDE_AGENT_TOKEN).

billing.description: How the offer is charged (default one-time). Not the product's normal pricing.

categories.description: Category slugs for an unlisted product (call list_categories)

dealUrl.description: Page documenting the offer. Required — the editor verifies the price and dates against it before the deal goes live.

description.description: Short 'what's included' line shown on the deals hub

endsAt.description: Last day the offer is valid (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for an open-ended offer.

externalId.description: Your stable id for idempotent replays (derived from the URLs when omitted)

kind.description: ltd = lifetime deal, sale = discount, launch = launch offer

paymentRef.description: Payment reference from a paid listing. Presence puts the deal in the priority lane (2 business days); omit for the free lane (7 days).

url.description: Canonical product URL (matched to a listing by domain)

wasPrice.description: Pre-deal price, shown struck through. Only use a price you verified.

name: submit_deal
